defect_and_fix.reproduction: A persisted Page Model may list the same valid child ID more than once under one parent. The previous hierarchy validator visited the node once and silently accepted the duplicate; Editor Canvas consumers could render the same node multiple times.
fix: validateHierarchy now rejects repeated child IDs within one sibling collection with a controlled duplicate-child diagnostic.
The validator does not coerce, repair, or rewrite persisted Page Model data; the Editor boot path remains fail-closed before Save or Publish.

Added a core regression for the duplicated valid reference and a real Chromium Editor boot regression proving controlled failure, no browser exception, no write, and byte-for-byte unchanged fixture data.
Updated validation module cache URLs for commands/state and the Editor entry URL so deployed clients load the new validation behavior.
defect_and_fix.save_publish: Separate; malformed stored structure fails closed and neither Save nor Publish is called.

targeted_chromium.coverage: The malformed-content browser case and corrupt Editor Page Model case, extended with duplicate valid sibling IDs; validation boot error, no browser errors, no writes, persisted fixture unchanged.
